popup_subtitle: Configure your AI provider and quiz settings.
options_subtitle: Configure your AI provider and when quizzes appear.
popup_quiz_enabled_sub: Toggle off to watch without quizzes
options_quiz_enabled_sub: Pause to disable quizzes for the current session
popup_onboarding_step2: Get an API key via the link that appears.
options_onboarding_step1: Choose a provider below — Google Gemini is free with a Google account.
options_onboarding_step2: Get an API key using the link that appears after selecting a provider.
options_onboarding_step3: Paste the key — models load automatically and settings are saved. You're ready to go!
ondevice_not_downloaded: The on-device model hasn't been downloaded yet.
ondevice_unsupported: On-device AI isn't available on this browser or device.
ondevice_download_hint: This is a one-time download — once it's ready, quizzes run fully offline with no further downloads.
ondevice_unavailable_desc: Your browser or device doesn't support Chrome's built-in AI. Use a cloud provider instead — it just needs a free API key.
popup_api_key_desc: Stored locally via chrome.storage, only sent to your chosen provider.
options_api_key_desc: Stored locally via chrome.storage and only used to call the selected provider from your browser.
popup_model_desc: Enter your API key to load available models.
options_model_desc: Enter your API key then click Fetch models to load available models.
popup_quiz_interval_desc: How often to pause and show a quiz (minutes of watch time).
options_quiz_interval_desc: How often to pause and show a quiz, in minutes of watch time.
popup_quiz_num_questions_desc: Number of multiple-choice questions to generate.
options_quiz_num_questions_desc: Number of multiple-choice questions to generate each time.
quiz_no_transcript_error: No transcript available. Ensure the video has captions and try again.
